title: Haven: participant-list role changes (bans) are not authorized on the wire at b7ac262
description:
Run 2026-11-16 00:35Z, mimid-chat 68061c5 (/roles ban-no-banned, /policy, /ban) against our Haven copy haven.reviewcommit.com upgraded to b7ac262 (rollback /usr/local/bin/mimi-hubd.pre-b7ac262 on 172.31.40.164). Room r/ban-b003515, alice and carol (mimid.reviewcommit.com users). A ban into role 1 with role 1 undefined was accepted (epoch 4, carol's leaf removed); a second with role 1 defined also accepted (epoch 6).

Cause (Haven b7ac262 source): the update path applies changedRoleParticipants straight to the stored list (mimi-hubd/src/lib.rs ~L1340-1375); Hub::authorize_role_change (L858-872, which calls RoomPolicy::authorize_role_change, where the role-1 rule of d10086c/b7ac262 lives) is called only from tests (L1761-1770). So neither canBan, the actor's authorized_role_changes, nor role 1's existence is checked for a Commit. Haven is commercial: report in #mimi with Mark's OK, no issues/PRs.
notes:
2026-11-16 01:13Z rerun on our copy upgraded to Haven fcbe046 (live on Jason's hub 01:04Z): ban into undefined role 1 refused (invalidProposal, empty list, 'a participant is given a role the room's policy does not define'); with role 1 defined, accepted (epoch 5). Jason (238470): committer authority (canBan, canKick, canChangeUserRole, add/remove, actor's authorized_role_changes) still unchecked, needs the ratchet tree; DIV-15 says so. Rollback binaries on 172.31.40.164: mimi-hubd.pre-b7ac262.
Follow-up for the committer-authority half (still unchecked on Haven): mimid-1wgh.46.20.3, under the January interop day bead mimid-1wgh.46.20.
2026-11-17: at Haven fdce222 committer authority is checked, but only in a tracked room (one seeded by a Commit bundle with Full GroupInfo + full tree). Verified locally: ban without canBan, ban outside authorized_role_changes, add without canAddParticipant all refused notAllowed in a tracked room, accepted in an untracked one. mimid clients do not seed tracking today: mimid-1wgh.46.20.7. Details: mimid-1wgh.46.20.3.
